newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 192,500 running bales (RB) were off one-quarter from the previous week's marketing-year high and 2 percent from the 4-week average. The major increases were for China (92,300 RB), Turkey (39,600 RB), South Korea (18,600 RB), Taiwan (10,500 RB), and Canada (8,300 RB).
Sales for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year of 52,100 RB were mainly for Ireland (48,000 MT).

Exports of 150,000 RB were 18 percent above the previous week, but 9 percent less than the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 74 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 22 percent; and West European, 4 percent.
